scope.important_rule: No government scheme is displayed for low/moderate disease severity. A disease class alone is never sufficient to establish eligibility.

decision_rules: Only evaluate this KB when the existing model/system provides severity = severe or critical.
Severity must come from the application's existing severity output; do not infer severity from disease name.
A severe disease prediction does not automatically mean crop loss or insurance eligibility.
Check state, crop, notified crop/area/season, enrollment/insurance status and other scheme gates.
Show at most 1-2 highly relevant schemes in the compact UI.
Use 'Potentially relevant' / 'Eligibility requires verification' instead of claiming guaranteed eligibility.
If no scheme passes the hard gates, show no scheme card.

schemes.why_relevant: Potential crop-loss insurance pathway when the crop, area, season and loss are covered under the current notification and the farmer has the required insurance/enrollment status.
schemes.source_note: Tamil Nadu's official PMFBY tender repository lists current notified crop/coverage annexures and participating insurance arrangements; current notification must be checked before showing a crop-specific claim pathway.

schemes.scheme_name: Kerala Restructured State Crop Insurance Scheme
schemes.why_relevant: Potential crop-loss compensation pathway for covered crops when the scheme's loss conditions and enrollment requirements are met.
schemes.special_disease_rule: For pest/disease loss, the cited 2025 Kerala order specifically states compensation for paddy; do not generalize this disease-loss provision to tomato, potato or corn.
schemes.important_loss_rule: The cited order states partial damage is not taken into account and paddy compensation is provided in full when crop loss is more than 50%.
schemes.source_note: Official Kerala 2025 order: AIMS registration is mandatory; applications are submitted through AIMS within the specified period after calamity; complete-damage and paddy pest/disease provisions are defined in the order.

schemes.scheme_name: Kerala Contingency Programme for Natural Calamities and Pest & Disease Endemic
schemes.why_relevant: Departmental emergency-support pathway when a pest/disease endemic or natural calamity response is officially activated.
schemes.source_note: Kerala's Annual Plan includes a contingency programme for natural calamities and pest/disease endemic with crop-health and affected-farmer support components.

schemes.why_relevant: Tamil Nadu has an official PMFBY implementation/tender system with cropwise and seasonwise notified coverage; exact crop eligibility must be checked in the current notification.
schemes.source_note: The Tamil Nadu official repository publishes notified crop/coverage annexures and PMFBY tender documents for current implementation.

no_scheme_rule: If severity is low or moderate, or if a severe/critical case does not satisfy a scheme's hard gates, return an empty recommendation list rather than showing a generic scheme.

ui_output_rule.disclaimer: Potentially relevant. Final eligibility and claim approval must be verified with the official department/portal.
